title: Wynwood Walls

Located in the vibrant Wynwood Arts District of Miami, our venue at Wynwood Walls offers garden areas, gallery vibes and world-famous street-art as your backdrop. Whether you’re planning a corporate gathering, social celebration or brand activation - we deliver unforgettable experiences We proudly offer our museum as a premier venue for events, and group gatherings both personal and professional. Located in what Vogue calls one of the coolest neighborhoods in the world, your event will provide an unforgettable backdrop.
